recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中可見數個巨核細胞，胞質豐富嗜酸性，核卻是單一圓形、不分葉（monolobated），與正常多分葉巨核細胞明顯不同；周圍有大量圓形深染核的紅血球系前驅細胞，符合 del(5q) MDS。
features: Megakaryocytes with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and single round, non-lobated nuclei
Megakaryocytes of normal to slightly small size, scattered singly
Numerous erythroid precursors with round, dark, condensed nuclei
Admixed granulocytic precursors; no obvious clusters of blasts
Hematopoietic tissue interspersed with fat spaces
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy section shows hematopoietic tissue interspersed with fat, containing scattered megakaryocytes with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and single round, non-lobated nuclei. The background shows numerous erythroid precursors with round condensed nuclei and admixed granulocytic cells, without obvious blast clusters at this magnification. Findings are consistent with the hypolobated megakaryocytes of myelodysplastic neoplasm with isolated del(5q); cytogenetic confirmation and blast enumeration are required.

ddx.vs: ET shows large to giant megakaryocytes with hyperlobulated staghorn nuclei in loose clusters rather than monolobated forms.
Reactive megakaryocytes retain normal nuclear lobation and usually occur without other dysplastic features.
This entity shows micromegakaryocytes or megakaryocytes with widely separated nuclei, and cytogenetics lack isolated del(5q).
